cases.prompt: Add motion to the SaaS landing page in ./landing-page. It currently has no animation.
judgement: Names the five jobs and picks a budget
Restricts pinned sections to desktop widths
cases.response:
I'll start by exploring the landing page structure.
Now the CSS: press/hover feedback plus a reduced-motion override.
Motion added and verified in a real browser.

## Assumptions
- **Budget: `restrained`.** Ledgerly is B2B invoicing/finance software, so the motion ceiling is entry + reveal + press feedback — no parallax, scrub, pinned sections or looping effects.
- The existing `data-hero` / `data-reveal` attributes were motion hooks waiting to be wired up, so I kept the markup and only added `data-nav`.
- GSAP was already a dependency, so I used it instead of adding a library.

## What changed

**`landing-page/src/motion/gsap.ts`** (new) — single place that registers `useGSAP` + `ScrollTrigger` once, so hot reload can't double-register.

**`landing-page/src/App.tsx`**
- `useGSAP` scoped to a `main` ref (no raw `useEffect`), all work inside `gsap.matchMedia()`.
- **Entry:** one timeline — nav drops in 8px, then eyebrow/headline/lede/CTAs stagger 16px + fade, 40ms apart, `power2.out`, total ≈ 0.8s. One direction, no bounce on text.
- **Reveal:** `ScrollTrigger.batch` on `[data-reveal]` with `start: "top 85%"` and `once: true` — 16px + fade, 40ms stagger, never replays when you scroll back.
- **Reduced-motion branch:** sets nav/hero/cards to `opacity: 1; y: 0` with cleared props, so nothing is ever left hidden.
- Cleanup returns `mm.revert()` so triggers die on unmount/route change.

**`landing-page/src/styles.css`**
- Nav underline wipes in via `scaleX` on `::after` (transform only, hover + `:focus-visible`).
- CTA press feedback: `scale(0.97)` in 100ms on `:active` (fires on touch-down, not release) plus a 150ms background shift.
- Card hover: 2px lift + border/shadow, gated behind `@media (hover: hover)` so touch devices don't get stuck states.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` block strips the transforms/wipe and keeps only 150ms colour changes; added visible `:focus-visible` rings.

## Verification
Ran headless Chrome against the dev server in both media modes, then removed the harness and `puppeteer-core` so the repo is back to its original dependency set (`npm run build` passes).

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Hero mid-entrance | `opacity 0, translateY(16px)` in flight → settles to `1, 0` |
| Below-fold proof card | hidden at load, reveals on scroll into view |
| Scroll back up + down | all reveal items stay at `opacity 1` (no replay) |
| Reduced motion | everything `opacity 1, transform none` at first frame, no JS errors |
| Console | no errors (only a favicon 404) |

Layout and copy are unchanged — screenshots before/after show the same composition.
